item.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
item.description: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
item.description: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
item.description: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
item.description: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
item.description: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
item.description: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
item.description: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
item.description: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
item.description: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50, 34.3% above $83 IPO price
item.description: The Claude chatbot maker began trading under the ticker ANT, with the company’s valuation at around $2 trillion at the opening price.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea

item.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
item.description: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
item.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
item.description: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
item.description: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: IOSCO warns quantum upgrades could slow blockchains, leave security gaps
item.description: A Solana test network ran about 90% slower with quantum-resistant signatures, and wallets that keep using older keys could remain vulnerable.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
item.description: MAS issued the bills directly on its test network, which it plans to rename SG Digital Ledger and use for settlement beyond the trials.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin ETF assets fall to three-month low as 2026 net outflows top $2.5B
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $306.4 million Wednesday, pushing their combined assets to $77.7 billion as Bitcoin briefly traded below $63,000.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: BTCPay Server issues emergency update for 5 security flaws
item.description: The EU’s cybersecurity service said the flaws could let attackers to run malicious code remotely on vulnerable servers without logging in.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin retests $62K as Nasdaq futures rise ahead of Anthropic debut
item.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $63,500 after its second dip to $62,000 this week, while Anthropic priced its record $81.3 billion IPO at $83 a share.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Bitcoin carry trades could beat Treasury bills in 2027, Sygnum predicts
item.description: Sygnum predicts that Bitcoin carry trades may offer higher returns than Treasury bills in 2027, following a sharp drop in funding rates that made the strategy less compelling in 2026.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
item.description: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
item.description: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
item.description: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
item.description: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
item.description: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
item.description: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
item.description: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
item.description: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea

item.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
item.description: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
item.description: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski
